advanceBids.question: Can you make advance bids?
advanceBids.answer: v4, 1850, 1854, 1856, 1859, 1862, 1868, 1870, 1876 v2, 1876-30, 1876-30 v2, 1889, 1891, 1899, 18AL, 18C2C, 18CLE, 18EC, 18EZ Level 3, 18GA, 18GA v2, 18JP-T, 18Kaas, 18Mex, 18NK, 18NL, 18Rhl Rhineland, 18SS, 18SY, 18TN Yes, at 5 or more over face value and over any other bid.

buySellOrder.question: Is there a specific order to buying and selling on your turn?
buySellOrder.answer: Sell then buy, or buy then sell.

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: From the second stock round onwards.

poolLimit.question: Does the bank pool have a per-company share limit?
poolLimit.answer: 1865 Sardinia, 1867, 1868, 1869 The Golden Spike, 1870, 1876-30, 1876-30 v2, 1876-35 v2, 1879, 1883, 1889, 1895, 1899, 18??, 18AL, 18Ardennes, 18BL, 18C2C, 18Chesapeake, 18CLE, 18Dixie, 18EC, 18EU, 18EZ Levels 2 and 3, 18FL, 18GA, 18GA v2, 18GM, 18IN, 18Ireland, 18JP-T, 18Kaas, 18Mex, 18MS, 18MW, 18Neb, 18NK, 18NL, 18NW, 18NYC, 18Rhl Rhineland, 18Ruhr, 18SS, 18TN, 2038, Steam Over Holland 50%.

sameCompanyBuySell.question: Can you buy a certificate and immediately sell a certificate in the same company?

companyBuyShares.question: Can companies buy shares?
companyBuyShares.answer: Level 3, 18GA, 18GA v2, 18GM, 18JP-T, 18Kaas, 18Mex, 18MS, 18NK, 18NL, 18SS, 18SY-G Privates, in ORs, once a 3 train has been sold.

parPrice.question: How is a share company's initial (par) price determined?
parPrice.answer: There are no par prices. The initial price is set by the player who purchases the President's certificate, choosing a value selected from a range of predefined prices. All further share dealing is done at the current market price.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?

tileReplacement.question: Must a tile replacement extend existing track?
tileReplacement.answer: As for 1830, except that in the Green phase, a company may pay 50 to place a green tile directly on the map, skipping the normal yellow tile placement.

firstStationTiming.question: When is a company's first station marker laid?
firstStationTiming.answer: All Levels, 18GA, 18GA v2, 18JP-T, 18Kaas, 18Mex, 18MS, 18NK, 18NL, 18Rhl Rhineland, 18Ruhr, 18SA, 18SS, 18SY, 18TN, Steam Over Holland When it first operates.

twoStationsOneTile.question: Can one train run to two stations on the same tile?

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?
maxRevenue.answer: Yes. Players are not required to point out a higher revenue total than that claimed.

forcedTrainAfford.question: When a company is forced to buy a train and cannot buy one with its own means, what train may it then buy?

privateClosing.question: Does using a private company's special property close it?
privateClosing.answer: Yes, for the second to fifth private companies. The ACC also closes if a track connection is established between Antwerp and Liege.

answer.effects: train limit 4, 1 OR, Antwerp hex pays 20, lower values for OBHs and ports
Green tiles, privates may be bought by companies, 2 ORs, Antwerp hex pays 30
Brown tiles, train limit 2, 3 ORs, higher values for OBHs and ports, privates close

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: Brussels (F3) always pays double the value of the tile placed there. During the Green phase, a company may lay a green tile directly on the map for a cost of 50, which may be entirely paid by the company President if desired. Trains may only run from one off-board area to another if running from a southern OBH to a northern OBH. If this is done the run gains a bonus of 20.
